sn15.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn15.1:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 3
sn15.1:1.8: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ || || 4
sn15.1:1.9: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave purisoyaṃ imasmiṃ Jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhā palāsaṃ tacchetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā caturaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ ghaṭikaṃ karitvā nikkhippeyya ||
sn15.1:1.10: Ayaṃ me mātā tassā me mātu ayam mātā ti || || Apariyādinnā ca bhikkhave tassa purisassa mātu mātaro assu || atha imasmiṃ Jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhā palāsaṃ parikkhayam pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya || || 5
sn15.1:1.13: pubbakoṭi na pannāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ || || 6
sn15.1:1.14: Evaṃ dīgharattam vo bhikkhave dukkham paccanubhūtam tibbam paccanubhūtaṃ vyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ kaṭasi vaḍḍhitā || || 7
sn15.1:1.15: Yāvañcidam bhikkhave alam eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitunti || ||
